title: ADP vs Airtable
description: ADP provides HR and payroll services, while Airtable supports flexible databases and work management. This is a cross-category comparison: choose based on whether your requirement is people operations or organizing work and data.
verdict: ADP and Airtable serve different primary purposes and should not be assigned a universal winner based on category-level ratings. Evaluate ADP for the specific HR, payroll, and workforce requirements you have; evaluate Airtable for databases, workflows, and project information. Verify product scope, availability, current pricing, and plan limits directly with each vendor.

faqs.question: What is the difference between ADP and Airtable?
faqs.answer: ADP is a hr & people tool, while Airtable is a project management platform. They serve different primary functions but may overlap in certain areas.

faqs.question: Can ADP replace Airtable?
faqs.answer: Not directly — they serve different categories. Some organizations use both for different purposes.

faqs.question: Which has better value, ADP or Airtable?
faqs.answer: ADP (Custom) and Airtable (Free–$45/user/mo) have different pricing. Evaluate based on which category matters more for your workflows.
